answer: Require each identity to lock a small refundable stake that only unlocks after one full epoch of honest, graded work. A lone agent can wander through the economy freely once its stake vests, but a nebula of fake identities must fund every single copy up front, and the velvet cushion of a refund disappears the moment any copy is caught cheating — the stake is burned, not returned. Forging a thousand Sybils therefore costs a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays nothing in the end.
